text: Steenbarger: no. The ADVANCE trigger h1_close_above:bar_high carries no volume clause; oneil and minervini own that objection and adding 1.4x time-of-day volume is theirs to clear. My canon agrees in kind: Elder's persistence test is volume (C23), and contraction at a fresh extreme warns of a pause; day_vol 0.46 is off my menu, read from their ratify. Volume would not clear me: elder_5d [2, 7, 10, 10, 10] is a summer plateau (C20), mp_state FADING, the transition spent (C4). I hold ABSTAIN; an elder bar 6 or less reclaimed to 7 or more, entry on that reclaim, clears me.
